discription: A percussive filtered noise sound with a fast decaying envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=1000, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.1; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.001, 0.05, 0.0, 0.2, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = PinkNoise.ar(1.0); sig = LPF.ar(sig, freq, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
